frames.title: Video Formats Document Overview
frames.on_screen:
Document: 'Official - Avatar Mastery for Shopify Brands: The Meta-First Framework'

Video Formats:
Voiceover with b-roll:
- Voice-over footage/product shots (Real or AI)
- Usually has low-volume background music that flows with the ad
- Heavily edited with multiple clips (UGC, A-Roll, stock)
Example: https://ff.io/aodE075z

Subtitles with b-roll:
- Generated subtitles over footage/product shots (Taps into internal voice)
- Usually, has background music flows with the ad
- Heavily edited with multiple clips
Example: https://ff.io/PfaqXBS7

Slideshow Video w Text:
- Static images with transitions
- Heavy text overlay with movement
- Text reveals
Example (has video clips, but mainly referring to the "Images"):
https://ff.io/dGxD5UWH

Authentic UGC/Talking head only
- Person speaking directly to camera (can be real or AI - use ai ay your own risk)
- Casual, authentic feel
- Usually single-take or minimal editing
frames.not_in_transcript: Example URLs: https://ff.io/aodE075z, https://ff.io/PfaqXBS7, https://ff.io/dGxD5UWH. Note on document title: 'Official - Avatar Mastery for Shopify Brands: The Meta-First Framework'. Note under AI: 'use ai ay your own risk'.

Text content:
Professional shot video:
- CR8TIVE - Nurojit Video 1.mov
- High production value
- Professional lighting/equipment
- Polished, branded look

Animation:

- Colorfully designed graphics with text overlays (like Canva templates)

frames.title: Document: Product Photography + Headline Ad Examples and Infographics
frames.on_screen:
Product photography + Headline:
- Clean, professional photos of the product
- Can be on white/neutral backgrounds
- Can be lifestyle shots as well
Example:
- Ad 1: '12-HOUR SHIFT SHOES' showing orthopedic sneaker with bullet points: 'Made affordable for healthcare essential workers', 'Comfortable for back-to-back 12-hour shifts', 'Arch support for plantar fasciitis foot pain', 'Slip-resistant grip for fluids and slippery floor', 'Wide toe-box for bunions/hallux valgus', '#1 rated for comfort & cushion'
- Ad 2: 'INTRODUCING: 'The Manhattan City Runner'' shoe resting on fire hydrant

Infographic design:
- Visual charts, graphs, or step-by-step processes
- Combines data/info with visual design
- Example: '3 Steps to Better Sleep' with icons and text
Example:
- Foot reflexology/anatomy chart
- Laifen Dryers graph: 'Heat + Time = Damage / Laifen Dryers Protect Your Hair'
frames.not_in_transcript: Full copy of '12-HOUR SHIFT SHOES' ad; Ad headline: 'The Manhattan City Runner'; Infographic example note: '3 Steps to Better Sleep' with icons and text; Laifen Dryers ad headline: 'Heat + Time = Damage / Laifen Dryers Protect Your Hair'.

Infographic designs:

frames.title: Document: Native-Style Image and Quote/Text-Heavy Image Formats
frames.on_screen:
Native-style image:
• Designed to look like it's native to the platform (organic)
• Mimics organic social media posts (like Pubity style)
• Often looks "unbranded" or casual
• 🚨 IMPORTANT -> DO NOT FAKE PRESS RELEASE ADS (This is false advertising)

Example:
[Images: Pubity style ad for Achilles protection boot; USA TODAY headline ad for Carepod humidifier]

Quote/Text-heavy image:
• Mostly text with minimal design
• Quote-style layouts
• Text is the main focus, not visuals

Example:
[Images: Sciatic Nerve Pain Relief text ad; 5-star customer review quote ad]
frames.not_in_transcript: "🚨 IMPORTANT -> DO NOT FAKE PRESS RELEASE ADS (This is false advertising)". Pubity ad copy: "WHY RISK YOUR CAREER WITH EVERY GAME? THIS IS THE ACHILLES PROTECTION TRUSTED BY THE BEST IN THE WORLD..."

frames.title: Document: Quote/Text-Heavy Image and Collage Style Formats
frames.on_screen:
Quote/Text-heavy image:
• Mostly text with minimal design
• Quote-style layouts
• Text is the main focus, not visuals

Example:
[Images: Redlined article ad: "Eat This 1 Vitamin for Immediate Sciatic Nerve Pain Relief?"; 5-star customer testimonial card ad with oil bottles]

Collage style:
• Multiple images combined
• Grid layouts or scattered arrangement
• Shows multiple angles/uses
